note: Usually 物价 + 涨/高/低 for the general level, not one item's price (价格).

examples.zh: 最近物价涨了很多。
examples.en: Prices have gone up a lot lately.

examples.zh: 这个城市的物价高不高？
examples.en: Are prices high in this city?

examples.zh: 我觉得这里的物价比老家低。
examples.en: I think prices here are lower than in my hometown.

meaning: to prevent and treat (a disease, pest, pollution)

senses.en: to prevent and treat (a disease, pest, pollution)

note: Common in health notices: 防治 + disease/pest, e.g. 防治 疾病.

examples.zh: 医生说，这种病要早防治。
examples.en: The doctor says this disease must be prevented and treated early.

examples.zh: 我们社区正在做防治工作。
examples.en: Our community is doing prevention and control work.

examples.zh: 你知道怎么防治感冒吗？
examples.en: Do you know how to prevent and treat a cold?

meaning: to carry out, put into effect; to settle (a plan, arrangement)

senses.en: to carry out, put into effect; to settle (a plan, arrangement)

note: Often 落实 + 计划/政策/任务; also "confirmed" for arrangements (酒店 还 没 落实).

examples.zh: 这个计划什么时候能落实？
examples.en: When can this plan be put into effect?

examples.zh: 经理要求我们马上落实这件事。
examples.en: The manager asked us to carry this out right away.

examples.zh: 酒店还没落实，我有点儿担心。
examples.en: The hotel isn't settled yet, and I'm a bit worried.

note: Covers grain, vegetables, fruit, etc. from farms.

examples.zh: 这家超市的农产品很新鲜。
examples.en: This supermarket's farm produce is very fresh.

examples.zh: 周末我想去市场买些农产品。
examples.en: This weekend I want to go to the market and buy some farm produce.

examples.zh: 今年天气好，农产品价格比去年低。
examples.en: The weather is good this year, so farm produce is cheaper than last year.

examples.zh: 院子里有一棵桃树。
examples.en: There is a peach tree in the yard.

examples.zh: 春天，桃树开花了，很漂亮。
examples.en: In spring the peach trees bloom, and it's beautiful.

examples.zh: 这棵桃树是爷爷种的。
examples.en: Grandpa planted this peach tree.

meaning: Chinese set expression (usually four characters, often from a story)

senses.en: Chinese set expression (usually four characters, often from a story)

note: Learners often use 成语 to sound natural, but use them only where they fit the meaning.

examples.zh: 你会说几个汉语成语？
examples.en: How many Chinese idioms can you say?

examples.zh: 这个成语是什么意思？
examples.en: What does this idiom mean?

examples.zh: 老师说，学成语可以了解中国文化。
examples.en: The teacher says learning idioms helps you understand Chinese culture.

note: The Lunar New Year is 春节, not 元旦.

examples.zh: 元旦你们公司放假吗？
examples.en: Does your company have a holiday on New Year's Day?

examples.zh: 我们打算元旦去旅游。
examples.en: We plan to travel on New Year's Day.

examples.zh: 元旦那天，路上的人很多。
examples.en: On New Year's Day there were lots of people on the road.

examples.zh: 很多人给灾区送了水和衣服。
examples.en: Many people sent water and clothes to the disaster area.

examples.zh: 医生已经到了灾区。
examples.en: The doctors have already arrived in the disaster area.

examples.zh: 灾区的孩子需要帮助。
examples.en: Children in the disaster area need help.

note: Beijing 烤鸭 is the famous one; one whole duck is 一 只.

examples.zh: 来北京一定要吃烤鸭。
examples.en: When you come to Beijing you must eat roast duck.

examples.zh: 我们点一只烤鸭，再点两个菜吧。
examples.en: Let's order a roast duck and two more dishes.

examples.zh: 这家的烤鸭太好吃了，你吃吧。
examples.en: This place's roast duck is so good; have some.

note: 水灾 stresses the damage; a plain "flood" is often 洪水.

examples.zh: 去年夏天这里发生了水灾。
examples.en: A flood hit this place last summer.

examples.zh: 水灾以后，很多人没有家了。
examples.en: After the flood, many people had no home.

examples.zh: 今年会不会有水灾？
examples.en: Will there be a flood this year?

meaning: all one saw was...; (suddenly) one saw (narrative)

senses.en: all one saw was...; (suddenly) one saw (narrative)

note: Narrative/written style: 只见 introduces what the narrator sees, often a sudden scene.

examples.zh: 我一打开门，只见地上全是水。
examples.en: The moment I opened the door, all I saw was water on the floor.

examples.zh: 他走进房间，只见桌子上放着一个大蛋糕。
examples.en: He walked into the room and saw a big cake on the table.

examples.zh: 车停了，只见司机跑了出来。
examples.en: The car stopped, and out ran the driver.

meaning: I don't deserve it; you flatter me (polite reply to praise)

senses.en: I don't deserve it; you flatter me (polite reply to praise)

note: Polite response to praise or an honor; modest, a bit formal.

examples.zh: 您太客气了，不敢当！
examples.en: You're too kind; I don't deserve it!

examples.zh: 大家叫我老师，我真不敢当。
examples.en: Everyone calls me teacher, but I really don't deserve it.

examples.zh: 让您请客，我实在不敢当。
examples.en: I really can't accept you treating me.

examples.zh: 你想去看大熊猫吗？
examples.en: Do you want to go see the giant pandas?

examples.zh: 动物园里有很多大熊猫。
examples.en: The zoo has many giant pandas.

examples.zh: 大熊猫每天吃很多竹子。
examples.en: Giant pandas eat a lot of bamboo every day.

note: Used in reports and bills, before a number or amount.

examples.zh: 这次旅行共计花了五千块。
examples.en: The trip cost five thousand yuan in total.

examples.zh: 今天共计有三十个人来。
examples.en: Thirty people came today in total.

examples.zh: 请问，这些菜共计多少钱？
examples.en: Excuse me, how much do these dishes come to in total?

meaning: to be hit by a disaster

senses.en: to be hit by a disaster

note: Verb-object: 受灾 (not "受灾害"); often 受灾 + 地区/人口.

examples.zh: 那里受灾很严重，需要帮助。
examples.en: That place was hit hard by the disaster and needs help.

examples.zh: 今年夏天，南方有很多地方受灾了。
examples.en: This summer, many places in the south were hit by disaster.

examples.zh: 受灾的家庭得到了食物和药。
examples.en: The disaster-hit families received food and medicine.

note: Often classical gardens, e.g. 苏州 园林.

examples.zh: 南方的园林很有名，我想去看看。
examples.en: The gardens in the south are famous; I'd like to see them.

examples.zh: 周末我们去了一个园林，人不多。
examples.en: We went to a garden at the weekend, and it wasn't crowded.

examples.zh: 这个园林里有水，有树，也有花。
examples.en: This garden has water, trees, and flowers too.

examples.zh: 我想买一个新书柜。
examples.en: I want to buy a new bookcase.

examples.zh: 这个书柜放不下这么多书。
examples.en: This bookcase can't hold so many books.

examples.zh: 书都在书柜里，你自己拿吧。
examples.en: The books are all in the bookcase; help yourself.

note: Praise for attitude: 虚心 学习/接受/听取.

examples.zh: 他很虚心，常常问同事问题。
examples.en: He is very modest and often asks colleagues questions.

examples.zh: 做研究要虚心，别人的意见也要听。
examples.en: In research you need an open mind and must listen to others' views.

examples.zh: 我会虚心接受大家的建议。
examples.en: I will take everyone's suggestions with an open mind.

note: Usually 占 ... 的 比重 or 比重 大/小.

examples.zh: 我们的支出里，房租的比重最大。
examples.en: In our spending, rent has the largest share.

examples.zh: 蔬菜在他的饮食里比重太小。
examples.en: Vegetables make up too small a share of his diet.

examples.zh: 网上购物的比重越来越大了。
examples.en: The share of online shopping keeps growing.

note: Goes before the verb or adjective; often a natural feeling in a situation.

examples.zh: 第一次出国，我不免有点儿紧张。
examples.en: On my first trip abroad, I was inevitably a bit nervous.

examples.zh: 每天加班，他不免有些累。
examples.en: Working overtime every day, he can't help feeling tired.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，大家不免担心起来。
examples.en: Hearing this news, everyone couldn't help but worry.
